GitHub API 可抓，**561 个 bounty issue**。提取完整清单。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const fs=require('fs');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
 "const q='https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=' + encodeURIComponent('is:open label:\"\u{1F48E} Bounty\"') + '&sort=created&order=desc&per_page=60';",
 "const pu=new URL(q);",
 "http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:q,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){",
 " let j;",
 " try{ j=JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')); }catch(e){ console.log('PARSE ERR', e.message); return; }",
 " console.log('TOTAL BOUNTY ISSUES:', j.total_count);",
 " const rows=[];",
 " for(const it of j.items){",
 " const repo=it.repository_url.split('/repos/')[1];",
 " const m=/(\\[[$\\u00a3\\u20ac]?\\s?[\\d,]+\\]|\\$\s?[\\d,]+)/.exec(it.title);",
 " const amt=m?m[0]:'(no amount)';",
 " rows.push({repo:repo, num:it.number, amt:amt, title:it.title.substring(0,110), comments:it.comments, created:it.created_at.substring(0,10), url:it.html_url});",
 " }",
 " fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bounties.json', JSON.stringify(rows,null,1));",
 " // print top 30 by comments (热度)",
 " const byHot=rows.slice().sort(function(a,b){return b.comments-a.comments});",
 " console.log('\\n=== 最热 20（按评论数）===');",
 " for(const r of byHot.slice(0,20)){ console.log(r.amt.padEnd(12)+' | '+r.repo+'#'+r.num+' | '+r.comments+'评 | '+r.created+' | '+r.title); }",
 " console.log('\\n=== 最新 20（按创建时间）===');",
 " for(const r of rows.slice(0,20)){ console.log(r.amt.padEnd(12)+' | '+r.repo+'#'+r.num+' | '+r.comments+'评 | '+r.created+' | '+r.title); }",
 " });",
 "});",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bounty2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bounty2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch and list all open bounty issues", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 9000));
", "description": "Fetch full bounty issue list from GitHub API"}

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const fs=require('fs');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
  "const q='https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=' + encodeURIComponent('is:open label:\"\u{1F48E} Bounty\"') + '&sort=created&order=desc&per_page=60';",
  "const pu=new URL(q);",
  "http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:q,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json'}},function(res){",
  "  const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "  res.on('end',function(){",
  "    let j;",
  "    try{ j=JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')); }catch(e){ console.log('PARSE ERR', e.message); return; }",
  "    console.log('TOTAL BOUNTY ISSUES:', j.total_count);",
  "    const rows=[];",
  "    for(const it of j.items){",
  "      const repo=it.repository_url.split('/repos/')[1];",
  "      const m=/(\\[[$\\u00a3\\u20ac]?\\s?[\\d,]+\\]|\\$\s?[\\d,]+)/.exec(it.title);",
  "      const amt=m?m[0]:'(no amount)';",
  "      rows.push({repo:repo, num:it.number, amt:amt, title:it.title.substring(0,110), comments:it.comments, created:it.created_at.substring(0,10), url:it.html_url});",
  "    }",
  "    fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bounties.json', JSON.stringify(rows,null,1));",
  "    // print top 30 by comments (热度)",
  "    const byHot=rows.slice().sort(function(a,b){return b.comments-a.comments});",
  "    console.log('\\n=== 最热 20（按评论数）===');",
  "    for(const r of byHot.slice(0,20)){ console.log(r.amt.padEnd(12)+' | '+r.repo+'#'+r.num+' | '+r.comments+'评 | '+r.created+' | '+r.title); }",
  "    console.log('\\n=== 最新 20（按创建时间）===');",
  "    for(const r of rows.slice(0,20)){ console.log(r.amt.padEnd(12)+' | '+r.repo+'#'+r.num+' | '+r.comments+'评 | '+r.created+' | '+r.title); }",
  "  });",
  "});",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bounty2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bounty2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch and list all open bounty issues", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 9000));
